display.purpose: Poster title. Hero h1 (own clamp 56px-10.6vw-204px, uppercase, 112% wide) and the contact e-mail (weight 500, normal width).

headline.purpose: Section heads, ticket title and price, mobile menu links; 900 at 112% width.

title.purpose: Card titles and footer links (112% wide), fact values, gallery count.

lead.purpose: Ledes, ritual text, FAQ questions, stepper count.

label.purpose: Fact labels, form labels, nav, captions, legal. Sentence case, no tracking.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: UI state changes, press, hover, nav underline.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Arrivals: hero title lines, picture settle and map fade-in, entrances.

motion.name: t-press
motion.purpose: Press feedback: buttons scale 0.97, tools 0.94, stepper 0.9.

motion.name: t-ui
motion.purpose: Chevrons, underlines, accordion height, footer link slide.

motion.name: hero-window
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub, clip-path from the 4:5 window to inset(0), over 0.95 viewport while the stage is pinned
motion.purpose: The poster window opens to full-bleed.

motion.name: entrance
motion.value: opacity 0 + translateY(24px) to rest, 0.9s expo.out, stagger 0.08s, once at top 86%
motion.purpose: Parts of a group arrive in reading order.

motion.name: shutter
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0), 1.2s power4.inOut; image scale 1.12 to 1 over 1.6s
motion.purpose: Photographs open from the lower edge.

motion.name: drift
motion.value: yPercent -4 to 3, scrubbed across the frame's pass
motion.purpose: Large photographs travel inside their frames.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all transitions and animations 1ms; hero unpinned; no Lenis; no entrances
motion.purpose: Content is in place without motion.

narrative.overview:
The site is a vintage Hautes-Alpes travel poster that keeps going as you scroll. Every section stands on a flat field of local colour: the pale sky, the blue-grey ridge of the Écrins, the turquoise of Serre-Ponçon, the yellow of the Embrun sun. One navy ink prints on all of them. Photographs are the client's own outings, set into the fields as windows, columns and halves, never tinted or framed with ornament.

Density is low and the scale is loud: poster titles in wide black Archivo hold the page, and everything else is set at normal width in a short six-step ramp. Depth comes from field changes and from photographs, not from light; there are no shadows, no gradients and no lines. The one drawn shape is the Écrins ridge silhouette, which closes the hero, seams the ticket into the page and sits at the foot of each ritual field.

Night mode is the same poster re-inked, not a different site: the fields drop to navy tones, the inks go pale, and the sun-yellow survives as the action colour and the ink of the former sun field.
keyCharacteristics: Flat colour fields (sky, lake, sun, paper, night) carry whole sections, each with its paired ink.
One family, Archivo, with the width axis: 112% black for poster titles, 100% for everything else.
Square corners everywhere; flat fills; no shadow at rest, no gradient, no hairline.
The real contour map of the Embrun valley is the only drawn element: full in the hero, faint crops on ritual fields.
Sun-yellow is the action colour in both themes.
Motion is a poster coming to life: a window that opens, lines that rise, pictures that open like shutters.

rules.name: The Field And Ink Rule
rules.body: A surface is always one of the five fields with its own paired ink. Never set text colour independently of the field it sits on.

rules.name: The Sun Is Action Rule
rules.body: Sun-yellow marks the thing to press. A sun field may host a section, but nothing on a non-sun field is yellow unless it is clickable or the selection.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: 112% width is for poster titles only (display, headline, card and footer titles). Text, labels and numbers stay at 100%.

rules.name: The Ritual Verb Exception
rules.body: The ritual verbs (ENFILER, ÉCOUTER, DESCENDRE, SÉCHER) are uppercase black at normal width with tight tracking (-0.045em, line-height 0.84); they are the only uppercase outside the hero.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Prices, slots and counts use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Poster Rule
rules.body: Depth is overlap and field contrast. If something needs to stand forward, put it on a different field; never lift it with a shadow.

rules.name: The One Map Rule
rules.body: The real valley map is the only illustration. No icons-as-decoration, no blobs, no wave dividers, no drawn mountain silhouettes.

dos: Do build every section on one field (sky, lake, sun, paper, night) with that field's ink.
Do make the thing to press a sun-yellow square rectangle with navy ink, 52px tall.
Do set poster titles in Archivo 900 at 112% width with tight negative tracking, and everything else at normal width.
Do let fields meet at straight edges; texture a colour panel only with a faint crop of the real map.
Do give outings fixed slots (duration, age, price) in the same order every time.
Do re-ink, not redesign, for night mode: same variables, same layout, sun stays the action.
Do honour reduced motion: content already in place, hero unpinned.
donts: Don't use gradients, including on photo overlays.
Don't use shadows at rest or on hover; depth is overlap and field contrast.
Don't draw hairlines, borders or dividers; separate with fields and space.
Don't put eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't number sections or items with index numerals (01, 02...). Counts like "1 sur 6" are fine.
Don't introduce a monospace or a second family.
Don't draw shapes other than the real map, and never bring back drawn mountain triangles.
